data.fund_type: An open-ended scheme replicating/tracking the Nifty 8-13 yr G-Sec Index. A Relatively High Interest Rate Risk andRelatively Low Credit Risk.
data.investment_objective: The primary goal is to provide returns that, before expenses, align with the total returns of the securities represented bythe Nifty 8-13 Yr G-Sec Index, subject to tracking error. There is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective ofthe scheme would be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Securities covered by Nifty 8-13 Yr G-Sec Index : 95% to 100% Debt and Money market instruments*,cash and cashequivalents : 0% to 5%
